summary: Iteration-7 verifies BUG-021/022/023/024 end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_bugfixes_iteration7.py (20 tests, 20/20 passing in ~16s). BUG-021: GET /api/sales/calls/0f00211c95ad4595b502249c01e5412e/recording returns 307 to a fresh Vapi presigned R2 URL (r2.cloudflarestorage.com), downloads with audio content-type when followed, 404 for nonexistent id, 403 for owner (non-superadmin). UI: Sales/Funnel -> Test Garage (+16476094072) opens prospect-sheet; call cards 0f00211c... and 8d71cb02... both render data-testid=call-audio-{id} (<audio controls>), call-recording-link-{id} (href=/api/sales/calls/{id}/recording). BUG-022: same call cards show data-testid=call-transcript-{id} with a <summary data-testid=call-transcript-toggle-{id}> that reveals the Vapi transcript (1222-1679 chars starting with 'AI: Hi. This is Riley from Rev Loop...'). BUG-023 code review: dial() writes sales.call.placed (success) and sales.call.failed (resolve_vapi or Vapi >=300); finish_call writes sales.call.completed; GET /api/admin/audits?action=sales.call surfaces sales.call.completed entries (verified via live API). BUG-024: POST /api/sales/prospects/{pid}/simulate-call with demo transcript (owner spells email 'jane at example dot com') -> response has wants_followup=true, email='jane@example.com', demo_time populated, followups[] has both {channel:sms,status:simulated,to:+1555...} and {channel:email,status:simulated,to:jane@example.com}; summary never contains 'booked'/'scheduled'/'confirmed'. Opt-out transcript ('remove me, stop calling') -> opt_out=true, outcome=do_not_call, followups empty, prospect becomes stage=do_not_call + dnc=true. Not-interested transcript -> outcome=not_interested, followups empty. sales.followup.sms / sales.followup.email audit entries written per followup. UI: TEST_Followup Garage call card showed data-testid=call-followups-{id} with 'FOLLOW-UPS\nSMS -> +15550109999 . simulated\nEMAIL -> test_owner@example.com . simulated' and both followup-{id}-sms and followup-{id}-email sub-rows present. Code review: sales.GUARDRAILS is appended to the Vapi assistant.model.messages system content in dial() (verified via inspect.getsource) and explicitly instructs the agent 'Never say the demo is booked or confirmed' and promises both an SMS + an email follow-up. Real (non-simulated) send path: _followup_sms uses _twilio(cfg).messages.create with sender from sms_sender(cfg) which prefers SALES_SMS_FROM then falls back to the Vapi phone number if it's a Twilio provider; _followup_email uses emailer.send_email (emergent email). SALES_SMS_FROM is in SETTING_KEYS and SETTING_DEFAULTS so it appears in Platform admin -> Integrations.

issues: Prospect stage pill still labels the demo_booked stage as 'Demo Booked' / 'DEMO BOOKED' - inconsistent with the GUARDRAILS 'Never say the demo is booked or confirmed'. Consider renaming the stage to 'demo_requested' or at least changing the UI label to 'Demo requested' while keeping the underlying stage code for backwards-compat. Carryover from iteration-6.

action_items: Consider renaming stage 'demo_booked' (and the kanban column) to 'demo_requested' to match the GUARDRAILS wording the AI uses on the call.

The real test call_logs 0f00211c... and 8d71cb02... were finished before BUG-024 shipped, so their followups[] is empty on the UI. New simulated calls correctly show the Follow-ups block. No action needed, but if a user retroactively wants recap SMS/email on those historical calls, they would need to be re-processed.
critical_code_review_comments: sales._followup_sms real path: if SMS_MODE is not 'live' it returns status 'simulated' even for a real (non-simulated) call. This is correct for the current platform (SMS_MODE=simulated by default) but means real production SMS sends silently become simulated unless SMS_MODE is flipped to live. Document that both SMS_MODE=live AND SALES_SMS_FROM (or Vapi+Twilio provider) are required.

sales.send_followups: when outcome is 'interested' or 'demo_booked' but wants_followup is False, follow-ups still fire. Intentional per the request, but worth noting the LLM has to flip wants_followup=true to collect the email - which it will if the GUARDRAILS prompt is followed. Edge case: 'interested' with no email given -> the email row is pushed with status='skipped' and error 'No email address given on the call.' - good.
sales._followup_email HTML is inline table + escape() of untrusted strings (name/summary/demo_time). Safe. Subject line concatenates ' & demo request' when demo_time truthy - correct.

GET /api/sales/calls/{log_id}/recording hits Vapi on every request to get a fresh presignedMonoUrl, then 307-redirects. Correct for presigned R2 URLs with short TTL, but on heavy traffic each playback = 1 Vapi API call. Consider caching the artifact URL for ~30s in Redis if listening at scale.

sales.py is now ~605 lines; still mixing prospects/DNC/campaigns/Vapi dial/summarise/followups/recording/webhook. Splitting into sales_prospects.py + sales_vapi.py + sales_followups.py would help maintenance per the 700-line guideline.

ProspectSheet shows p.calls[] with an <audio preload='none'> player that points to /api/sales/calls/{id}/recording - because browsers won't send credentials on <audio> src cross-site. Here the frontend and backend share the preview domain so the session cookie IS sent; good. If the backend ever moves to a separate subdomain, playback will break (cookie not sent on <audio> request). Document this.

rca of the issue:
BUG-021 cause: previous version returned the stored recording_url directly, which is a Cloudflare R2 object URL (not presigned) and R2 requires auth -> playback failed. Fix: GET /api/sales/calls/{id}/recording hits GET https://api.vapi.ai/call/{vapi_call_id}, pulls artifact.presignedMonoUrl or presignedStereoUrl, and 307-redirects. BUG-022 cause: transcript was never surfaced on the UI; finish_call writes it to call_logs.transcript, now the ProspectSheet renders a
Transcript
{c.transcript}
. BUG-023 cause: dial() previously did not write audit entries; added sales_audit('sales.call.placed') on 200/queued and sales_audit('sales.call.failed') on both resolve_vapi AppError and Vapi >=300. finish_call adds sales.call.completed. BUG-024 cause: GUARDRAILS were missing from the Vapi system prompt and finish_call never fired any follow-up messages. Fix: appended GUARDRAILS to the system prompt in dial(); added send_followups() -> _followup_sms + _followup_email called from finish_call. Simulated calls (log.simulated=True) return status='simulated' on both channels without hitting Twilio/email. Opt-out short-circuits followups and marks DNC. Follow-ups are also audited (sales.followup.sms / sales.followup.email).
